generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: real production Heroes III creature animation atlas, one original generic Bandle City Yordle Scout ONLY, not Teemo or a champion. Small furred wide-eared field yordle, tawny face, humble brown cloth vest, russet scarf, plain short leaf-shaped blade, little leather satchel; no hat plume, no helmet, no armor plate, no shield, no ranged weapon. ALL 48 cells show SAME individual and gear. Classic 1999 Heroes III prerendered painted texture, muted woodland moss and ochre colors, small readable silhouette, fixed slightly elevated RIGHT-facing three-quarter camera, upper-left light, actual transparent background. EXACT 6 columns 8 rows square-cell atlas 1536x2048. Consistent character scale and local cell baseline; full ears/blade/body inside each cell with 15% clear margins. Each row left-to-right: row1 SIX genuine walking phases alternating forward legs and passing knees, body planted at same height; row2 FIRST4 restrained blade-check fidget poses, FIFTH planted idle, SIXTH planted idle alternate; row3 FIRST3 hit-recoil poses, LAST3 defensive blade parry; row4 SIX successive real death-collapse poses from buckling knees to flat prone corpse, blade falls with body; row5 FIRST3 right-profile-to-front turning, LAST3 front-to-back turning; row6 SIX melee swings aimed diagonal UP; row7 SIX level melee swings; row8 SIX diagonal DOWN melee swings. Every attack: anticipation, backswing, lunge contact, followthrough, recovery, settled. Real limb/equipment pose changes, no translated idle clones. No text, no labels, no grids, no scenery, no floor disks, no haze, no glow, no plastic/mobile/anime style. No Demacia crest, Zaun chemtech, Noxus recolor. Sprite master for later native-size conversion.
generation.technical_method: Measured row-cohort registration; unmodified alpha, one uniform scale per atlas and shared native pivot. No pose synthesis or per-frame tight fitting.
